_meta.name: Themis rulepack
_meta.purpose: Declarative edits interpreted by engine/themis.mjs EVALUATORS (rule.type selects the evaluator).
_meta.note: Data-gated rules (ptp/mue/addon-primary/dx-gate/frequency) fire ONLY when their table is loaded into the pack; until then the engine reports them under meta.inactiveRules — it never fabricates a pass. The dx-gate rules below are payer-aware placeholders wired to real policy numbers (L35395 etc.); populate covered-dx.json from the real LCDs/CPBs to activate them.

rules.label: E/M + same-day procedure — modifier 25?
rules.fix: If the E/M is significant and separately identifiable from the same-day procedure, append modifier 25 and document the separate service. If it is not, do not bill the E/M.

rules.label: NCCI Procedure-to-Procedure edit
rules.fix: Indicator 0: do not bill the pair. Indicator 1: bill only with a documented override modifier (59/XE/XS/XP/XU) and supporting notes.

rules.label: Units exceed MUE
rules.fix: Reduce units to the MUE cap, split across dates of service, or document a valid MUE exception where the MAI allows it.

rules.label: Add-on code without a primary
rules.fix: Add the eligible primary procedure to the claim, or remove the add-on code.

rules.label: Preventive/AWV frequency
rules.fix: Confirm the covered interval against claims history / MAC before billing.

rules.label: Autonomic testing — covered diagnosis (Novitas L35395)
rules.fix: Bill only when the encounter carries a diagnosis on the L35395 covered list; otherwise expect a medical-necessity denial.

rules.label: Ambulatory BP monitoring — covered diagnosis
rules.fix: Confirm the encounter dx is on the ABPM covered list before billing.

rules.label: Remote physiologic monitoring — Cigna covered diagnosis
rules.fix: Confirm the encounter dx is on Cigna's RPM covered list before billing.
